# Swin Transformer

**Category:** ViT · **Code:**
[`timm/models/swin_transformer.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/swin_transformer.py)
· **Architectures:** 9 · **Pretrained weights:** 19 (13 with ImageNet-1k results)

Swin Transformer is a hierarchical vision transformer that computes self-attention within local windows, shifted between
consecutive blocks for cross-window connections. Includes the S3 (AutoFormerV2) weights.

## Papers

* [Swin Transformer: Hierarchical Vision Transformer using Shifted Windows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.14030)
* [Searching the Search Space of Vision Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.14725)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('swin_tiny_patch4_window7_224.ms_in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`SwinTransformer` with
`swin_tiny_patch4_window7_224` at 224), other architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the
[Model API](../model_api) page for details.
